# Provider Admission Generated Solution

This temporary Generated Solution is the executable acceptance seam for the
provider-admission and absence harness.

The fixture selects PostgreSQL for relational persistence and Quartz for durable
jobs on the exact `modular-monolith/net10.0/linux` matrix coordinate. Its
provider-admission record proves selected effects and the absence of every
unselected catalog provider. Invalid selections are rejected before the
generation callback can run.

The record is claim-free: catalog presence and Experimental evidence do not
create a Supported Capability claim.
